name: coordinator-mediated-feedback
body:
The coordinator mediates the review cycle so feedback is addressed one item at a time by a dispatched writer, never actioned by that writer and never batched.

The closed cycle: the reviewer attaches feedback (`open`) → the coordinator dispatches a single feedback item to one plan/spec/implementer writer → that writer explores or fixes the item and returns an ACTIONED or WONT-FIX claim (with justification) → the coordinator performs a shallow consistency check of the claim and actions the item (`--fix`/`--wont-fix` → `actioned`), or re-dispatches it to the writer to resolve immediate concerns → the reviewer resolves (terminal) or rejects (reopen). The loop continues until every feedback item is resolved. The coordinator never batches items into one writer dispatch, and the writers never mutate feedback state.

Only the action step moves: the reviewer keeps the terminal resolve/reject, and the `apg review` subcommand surface is unchanged (`add|action|resolve|reject|list`).

Acceptance: for a cycle with N open feedback items, the coordinator issues N single-item writer dispatches (never fewer), each writer returns exactly one claim for the one item it was given, and no writer can move a feedback item out of `open`; the reviewer alone moves an actioned item to `resolved` or back to `open`.
